title: Trade the Glass
subtitle: A trade, so it takes the panes
description: A trade, so it takes the panes: this task says `consumeItems: true`
and four glass panes go into it and do not come back.
Handing it in needs the panes to really be in the inventory, checked
by the button and then again by the server -- which is why a
consuming task has a Submit button and a counting one does not.
